card.name: Money, costs and budget shortfalls
card.fires_on: Words inside sentences about costs, spending limits, grants, prices and inflation, where the next words concern who pays or money lost. Often a small word like must, the, you, or part of a number.

modes.description: Words in sentences about expenses above a grant or limit and who must cover them.

modes.description: Words in warnings that unadjusted prices lose money.
